_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::poisson#0 — the dynamics section is 'SCALAR TRANSPORT DYNAMIC' spelled out, and no near miss falls back to defaults. Run on a self-contained stationary Poisson deck (unit square of TRANSP TRI3, TIMEINTEGR 'Stationary', phi=1 on the left edge and 0 on the right, exact centre value 1/2): the full spelling exits 0 with its result test CORRECT and prints 'Stationary    STEP = 1/1' (BASE_SOLVE_STEPS=1), while 'SCATRA DYNAMIC', 'SCALAR TRANSPORT DYNAMICS' and 'POISSON DYNAMIC' are each rejected by name from core/io/src/4C_io_input_file.cpp with "Section '<name>' is not a valid section name." and never reach the solve (ABBREV_SOLVE_STEPS=0). The 'unknown section' parser banner an earlier version of this entry quoted appears nowhere (CLAIMED_UNKNOWN_SECTION_TEXT=0). Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
